status: FROZEN FOR LIMITED ALTITUDE-AND-ROLL CONTROLLER COMPARISON ON 6-DOF PLANT; no final tests performed
why_new_seed: 2026101501 and earlier 100-condition results have appeared in prior working-document logs; never reuse them as blind

simulation_scope.propagation: 17-state nonlinear Newton-Euler quaternion model with 4 rotor speed states
simulation_scope.regulation: altitude z and Euler roll; no active x/y position, pitch or yaw control
simulation_scope.evidence: software-in-the-loop reconstruction ONLY; not original recovered source nor measured flight

randomization_and_independence.paired_noise: one common noise realization per physical condition, shared across controllers; separate stream from physical conditions
randomization_and_independence.old_sets_prohibited: previous 40-condition V1 / all already generated 100-condition V2 historical sets; required S1-S3 known, separate challenge diagnostics
randomization_and_independence.note: This is a synthetic distribution, not an empirical distribution of flight conditions. Pre-existing old protocol influenced current model development.

primary_endpoint.name: altitude task pass (NOT flight-safety pass)
primary_endpoint.criteria: all true: numerically finite; abs(roll)<65deg; max(abs(z))<25m; altitude settling time <=5.8s using +/-5% of 2m until horizon; altitude overshoot<=14%; abs(final altitude error)<=0.085m
primary_endpoint.horizon_censoring: if last sample outside settling band label not settled within horizon; keep 12s as censored for descriptive aggregates

secondary_pre_registered_continuous_metr: altitude settling time (and horizon censor status)
thrust increment RMS N (not total control effort)
max roll torque allocation gap Nm

secondary_diagnostic_violations.abs_unwrapped_yaw_over_45_deg: illustrative only; not a physically certified yaw envelope
secondary_diagnostic_violations.max_horizontal_drift_over_2_m: illustrative only; not a certification threshold
secondary_diagnostic_violations.max_roll_over_25_deg: illustrative only; selected after observing development behavior; descriptive not confirmatory

stats_plan.proportions: Wilson 95% confidence intervals for each 100-case altitude-task pass fraction
stats_plan.paired_comparisons: for each Auto-PID / LQR compared with tuned conventional PID: McNemar exact paired discordant-case test; Holm correction across 3 planned comparisons
stats_plan.continuous_differences: paired difference in per-condition settling, IAE, roll IAE, yaw/drift and saturation, show mean and percentile bootstrap 95% CI with pre-fixed 10000 resamples / fixed analysis seed; also report raw effect sizes and failures
stats_plan.exploratory: no claim of general 3D flight safety; disclose all failed and unstable cases, avoid cherry-picking best metric
stats_plan.interpretation: 100 synthetic independent condition draws paired across 4 controllers; CIs characterize this simulator/uncertainty distribution only

sealed_rules: NO changes to code/parameters/metric thresholds after final scenario outcomes are viewed
If bug forces correction, quarantine the final set and state results are no longer blind; define a new prospective study
Report unfavorable Auto-PID outcomes even if conventional PID or LQR outperforms it
Never represent professor as supervisor/reviewer/coauthor without explicit agreement

audit.limits: yaw roll pitch and lateral flight envelope are not stabilized by this controller design
